title: RLDE: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Interpretable Iterative Document Editing
abstract: arXiv:2611.22039v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Improving the quality, clarity, and flow of long documents remains a challenging problem in NLP, as human editing typically occurs through iterative refinement rather than a single-pass rewrite. Most existing automated systems act as black-box generators or rely on supervised learning, limiting interpretability and failing to capture the sequential nature of revisions. In this paper, we propose RLDE, an automated end-to-end metric-driven RL framework that formulates document revision as a reference-free MDP problem (unsupervised with respect to paired document-revision targets). Working with a limited action space (NOOP, INSERT, DELETE, REPLACE), RLDE leverages Pointer Networks for dynamic span selection at the token level and sends generative actions to the frozen BART-base model to obtain context-aware suggestions. translated_title: RLDE：一个用于可解释迭代文档编辑的强化学习框架
translated_abstract: 提升长文档的质量、清晰度和流畅性仍然是自然语言处理（NLP）中一个具有挑战性的问题，因为人工编辑通常是通过迭代式润色而非一次性重写完成的。现有的大多数自动化系统要么充当黑盒生成器，要么依赖监督学习，这限制了可解释性，并且无法捕捉修订过程的序列特性。本文提出了RLDE，一个自动化的端到端、指标驱动的强化学习框架，它将文档修订形式化为一个无参考的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）问题（相对于成对的文档-修订目标而言是无监督的）。在有限的动作空间（NOOP、INSERT、DELETE、REPLACE）下，RLDE利用指针网络在词元级别进行动态片段选择，并将生成式动作发送给冻结的BART-base模型以获得上下文感知的修改建议。PPO智能体学习优化基于可读性、困惑度和语法指标的多目标奖励函数……
tldr: 提出了RLDE框架，将文档迭代修订建模为无参考的MDP问题，通过指针网络与PPO智能体结合冻结的BART模型，依据可读性、困惑度和语法等多目标奖励实现可解释的自动化文档编辑。
en_tdlr: RLDE formulates document revision as a reference-free MDP, leveraging Pointer Networks and PPO agents with a frozen BART model to achieve interpretable, iterative document editing optimized by multi-objective readability, perplexity, and grammar rewards.
